# Air Quality Advisor v0.2.8 — Fix broken images in HACS

This maintenance release fixes the missing README images on the **HACS repository detail page**. GitHub supports README-relative image URLs, but HACS renders the README in a separate context where `.github/assets/...` links do not resolve.

## What changed

- Converted all nine repository-hosted README images to absolute `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Chreece/HA-Air-Quality-Advisor/main/.github/assets/...` URLs.
- Restores the project banner, Ko-fi graphic, workflow diagrams, four sample dashboard screenshots (including the Greek-language view), and visual recommendation previews in HACS.
- Added a regression test verifying image links use absolute HTTPS URLs and that each repository asset exists.

## Compatibility

This is a documentation presentation fix only. No changes to mold indication, air quality evaluation, temperature calibration, configuration flows, notifications, Announcement Hub, or automation timing.

After HACS refreshes the repository page, the images should display. You do not need to restart Home Assistant for the README itself. Existing v0.2.7 installations remain functional.
